newsitem.title: UK: CLM tells HCG shareholders reject BRIT.
newsitem.headline: CLM tells HCG shareholders reject BRIT.

text.p: Lloyd's of London investment trust CLM said on Friday it had advised shareholders in HCG Lloyd's Investment Trust (HCG) to reject an offer by Benfield & Rea Investment Trust for HCG.
Benfield's 78 million stg bid for HCG, launched earlier this month, topped the 72 million proposed merger between HCG and CLM, which last week extended its offer for HCG to September 5.
BRIT on Thursday night posted its offer document for HCG.
"Nothing in that document has altered (CLM's board) view that the merger of HCG with CLM is in the interests of both sets of shareholders," said CLM in a statement.
"Accordingly, the board of CLM urges HCG shareholders to accept its offer."
Nobody at HCG was immediately available for comment.
